profile.headline: Software Engineer II | Java & Web Systems | AEM
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience building and maintaining enterprise web platforms in the financial services industry at USAA.
 
I specialize in backend and web platform development using Java, JavaScript, and modern web technologies, with a focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
 
Recently, I’ve been leading efforts to refactor a large-scale on-prem AEM codebase to meet cloud-native standards for migration to AEM as a Cloud Service, improving system compatibility, performance, and long-term maintainability.
 
My experience includes:
 
 - Designing and implementing web platform solutions across multiple domains (web & mobile routing) 
 - Supporting production systems in on-call rotations 
 - Collaborating across infrastructure, mobile, and platform teams 
 - Writing clear technical documentation to improve team velocity 
 
I’m particularly interested in roles involving distributed systems, cloud architecture, and scalable backend services, where I can continue growing while delivering meaningful impact.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Refactored enterprise AEM codebase to align with cloud-native standards, enabling migration to AEM as a Cloud Service
• Identified and resolved technical debt through BPA (Best Practice Analyzer) findings, improving system performance and maintainability
• Designed and implemented domain-routing solution to direct users to appropriate web or mobile experiences based on device detection
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams (infrastructure, mobile, routing) to deliver scalable platform solutions
• Participated in on-call rotation supporting production AEM environments, troubleshooting critical issues and ensuring uptime
• Developed and maintained custom AEM components using Java (Sling Models), HTL, JavaScript, and CSS
• Authored technical documentation for environment setup, component usage, and developer onboarding

positions.title: Assistant Director of Intramural Activities
positions.description:
• Oversaw intramural leagues and events including activity implementation, marketing & promotion, participant conduct & eligibility, logistical operations & strategic planning, and compilation of semester & annual reports
• Recruited, hired, on-boarded, trained, supervised, scheduled, evaluated, mentored and facilitated professional development for a team of 40+ student employees 
• Addressed participants and staff regarding policies, behavioral expectations, enforcement of rules, and resolved conduct issues as needed
• Trained in motivational interviewing and led de-escalation trainings resulting in decreased sportsmanship penalties administered to participants
positions.insights: Skills: Organization Skills · Team Leadership · Coaching · Team Building · Refereeing

positions.title: Customer Service Specialist
positions.description:
• Contracted by Harland Clarke from their outbound call center, provided Bank of America client education and support regarding small business and consumer credit cards to increase client product satisfaction and engagement. Consistently achieved ‘exceeds’ level in monthly metrics for quality of calls and productivity
• Performed data quality maintenance on client accounts and addressed client problems and complaints resulting in reliable information and client issue resolution
• Ensured privacy and security of Bank of America client accounts resulting in compliance to federal banking regulations

positions.title: Medical Scribe
positions.description:
• Prepared bed-side electronic medical records for physician examinations in fast-paced ER environment using medical record software resulting in real-time documentation 
• Performed and detailed data entry for facility-specific procedures, organized and sent all documentation to physicians for review and approval
• Enabled higher patient volumes and billing accuracy resulting in increased care quality

positions.title: Property Manager
positions.description:
• Responsible for managing daily site operations to ensure effective financial, physical and social soundness of rental properties
• Performed unit inspections, rent collections, maintenance supervision, time-sensitive financial and market reports, new-hire interviews resulting in improved client relations and efficient upkeep
• Completed all leasing duties including marketing, contract negotiation, background checks requiring daily telephone and digital communication

positions.title: Recruitment Specialist
positions.description:
• Collaborated with doctors and patients to enroll subjects for clinical drug trials
• Informed, screened and advised patients on benefits of joining applicable studies 
• Scheduled patient clinic visits, collected provider medical records, created patient files, adhered to stringent U.S. Government Food & Drug Administration protocol
